title: DEPHYRIER Kein Edit (Scan First No Code Yet)
style: audit pulse 96 bpm trilingual EN DE FR DEPHYRIER signature dependency-scan-first read-before-write cold-pad clean-snare spoken-german ledger-tone
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
April fourteen the dependency scan came in
No code edits yet the post said cleanly thin
Read the surface name the packages out loud
Recommend before commit not the other way around

[Pre-Chorus — German]
Kein Code-Edit zuerst nur die Prüfung
(No code edit first only the check)
Lesen vor Schreiben das ist die Führung
(Read before write that is the guidance)

[Chorus — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER scan first commit later sane
Kein Edit ohne Lesen die Disziplin
(No edit without reading the discipline)
Pas d'édition avant l'analyse
(No edit before analysis)

[Verse 2]
Dependency surface mapped before the patch
Safer than the cowboy commit and dispatch
No code edits yet the phrase that earns trust
Read audit recommend then adjust

[Bridge — French]
Lire avant d'écrire la règle classique
(Read before writing the classic rule)
Le scan d'abord puis la modif appliquée
(The scan first then the modification applied)

[Outro — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER scan first no edit yet
Kein Code-Edit lectura primero
DEPHYRIER lis avant d'agir
